The atom, cloud, matter and shell schematic views are teaching illustrations. They do not calculate quantum orbitals or element-specific crystal structures. Bohr rings and detail diagrams use sourced neutral-atom shell populations; nuclei use representative isotope counts. The introduction retains its separate practice model. See scientific sources and limitations.
features: First-time visitors get a four-step introduction with an interactive Three.js atom, animated text and real app screenshots. Practice swipe, rotation, zoom and element details, then start exploring. Replay it anytime…

One Element library combines typo-tolerant search, family cards and the periodic table; switching views preserves the query and family filter. Favorite an element or open its story from the same library.

Pinch to zoom, spread the electrons, and reset the view from Settings. Hold the atom to reveal proton and electron counts. Stories include scientific shell diagrams with pause controls; games include explicit rotation,…
